maddeler.e:
يهرر (form I)
# يَهْرِرْ (yahrir) /jah.rir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# يُهْرَرْ (yuhrar) /juh.rar/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
